description: This is a Bash shell script intended to run L1 tests, handle patch application idempotently, ensure external repositories are cloned at specific revisions, and perform build and test steps for a CMake-based project. It includes functions for patch application, repository management, build orchestration, and environment setup. The script is used in a CI/CD workflow to ensure consistent environment setup, patching, building, and testing of the entservices appgateway project and related dependencies.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Applies a patch idempotently and non-interactively; skips if already applied.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Resets the ThunderTools directory to a specified git revision, ensuring the patch baseline.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Builds the project via CMake, runs tests with ctest, and optionally generates coverage reports.

methods.name: ensure_repo_cloned
methods.description: Ensures a git repository is cloned at a specific ref, recloning if needed.

methods.name: ensure_l1_workflow_repos_present
methods.description: Clones required repositories for the workflow from external sources at specified refs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for orchestrating repo setup, patch application, building, and testing.
